# ELK layout engine

`elk.bundled.js` and `LICENSE.md` are distributed from `elkjs@0.11.0`
(https://www.npmjs.com/package/elkjs). The engine is served locally and loaded by
the model-layout Worker. No CDN or runtime package download is required.

To update, extract these two files from the pinned npm package and rerun
`node scratch/check_model_layout.cjs` and the browser checks.
